title: The Harbor of Rosewater Lane
author: Xanthe Hartwell
blurb: Petra Coldharbour, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
